en.title: Pixform: free photo transformation and still-image face swap
en.summary: Pixform offers image-to-image style transformation and a separate two-photo still-image face-swap workflow. Public terms describe limited free use without signup; GIF, selectable multi-face and video swaps are not available in this release.
en.detail:
Pixform at pixform.ai is a lightweight photo transformation service. Its home page describes uploading a JPG, PNG or WEBP image up to 10 MB, choosing one of six styles and generating a still image. A separate face-swap page describes a still-image workflow with a source photo and one reference portrait. These are vendor-described features; we did not submit photos or test results, likeness, safety controls or service reliability. The product is positioned for creative reinterpretation, not precise retouching or guaranteed identity preservation.

The Terms say the initial service is free, requires no account and is limited to 10 generation attempts per IP address per hour, subject to capacity. There is no paid subscription in the described initial release. The privacy policy says selected photos are sent to Replicate for processing and that uploads/results become inaccessible one hour after processing finishes, with deletion from temporary storage on the next cleanup run; unfinished jobs expire after two hours. Replicate and Cloudflare process data under their own policies. Temporary result links should be treated as private, and the policy cautions against sensitive uploads.

Pixform's roadmap page explicitly labels Face Swap GIF, selectable Multiple Face Swap and Video Face Swap as planned or under consideration, and says the current tools work with still images. This listing treats those as unavailable, not launched capabilities. In the current face-swap workflow, the page recommends one person per photo. Commercial use depends on source-image permissions, model licenses and third-party rights; output uniqueness and likeness are not guaranteed. Public pages do not identify a legal operating entity, so this listing does not infer one.

Best for casual experiments that restyle a still photo or compare a two-photo face swap. Not ideal for production retouching, guaranteed likeness, animation/video workflows, multi-person batch editing, sensitive imagery or predictable capacity. Compare image transformation tools on style control, preservation of source details, upload retention, hourly limits and consent safeguards. No Task Fit or Task Page is created by this selection.

Users wanting to try a separate two-photo still-image face swap with permission from the people shown
notIdealFor: Production work requiring precise retouching or guaranteed identity preservation

limitations: Still-image tools only; GIF face swap, selectable multiple-face swap and video face swap are explicitly planned/under consideration, not available
Face swap guidance is for one person in each photo; outputs and likeness can vary
Free use is limited to 10 attempts per IP address per hour and subject to capacity

cn.title: Pixform：免费照片转换与静态图片换脸
cn.summary: Pixform 提供图生图风格转换，以及独立的双照片静态换脸流程。公开条款称初期版本可限量免费使用且无需注册；GIF、可选多脸和视频换脸尚未上线。容量及数据处理仍有边界。
cn.detail:
Pixform 位于 pixform.ai，是轻量照片转换服务。官网介绍上传不超过 10 MB 的 JPG、PNG 或 WEBP 图片，从六种风格中选择并生成静态图片。另一个独立换脸页面介绍使用一张场景照片和一张参考人像的静态换脸流程。这些是厂商描述；本站未上传照片或测试结果、肖像相似度、安全控制或服务可靠性。产品定位是创意改写，不是精确修图或保证身份不变。

服务条款称初期版本免费、无需账户，每个 IP 地址每小时最多 10 次生成尝试，且受服务容量影响；所述初期版本没有付费订阅。隐私政策称用户选中的照片会发送至 Replicate 处理；处理结束后一小时，上传图片和结果将不可访问，并在下一次临时存储清理任务中删除；未完成任务两小时后过期。Replicate 与 Cloudflare 依各自政策处理数据。临时结果链接应视为私密，政策建议不要上传敏感内容。

Pixform 的路线图页明确将 Face Swap GIF、可选择的 Multiple Face Swap 和 Video Face Swap 标记为计划中或考虑中，并说明现有工具处理静态图片。本条目将它们视为不可用功能，不写成已上线。当前换脸流程建议每张照片各有一人。商用取决于原图许可、模型许可和第三方权利；不保证输出唯一或肖像相似。已核阅的公开页面没有说明法律运营实体，因此本条目不推断运营公司。

适合尝试静态照片风格转换或双照片换脸。不适合生产修图、保证肖像相似、动画/视频流程、多人物批量编辑、敏感图像或要求稳定容量的工作。可比较风格控制、原图细节保留、上传留存、每小时限额和同意保护。本选择不创建 Task Fit 或 Task Page。
